title: How to Achieve Full-Width Background Color for Landing Page Sections
text:
## How to Achieve Full-Width Background Color for Landing Page Sections
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101414
The key is to first add a 1x1 table, give it a background color, then drop the other tables or content blocks within that 1x1 table.

## Create the Web Page Section
Go to My Content
Click on Web Page Builder
Create or Edit a web page
Click in Page Options and set the page to be Full Screen Page Width:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181780170/original/mqBnRfKWZGYNuRlrWhsl6s7FUUehJVV-xg.png?1783619045 | alt: ]
Use the Table option in the editor:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181780194/original/42EliCWNKwox3SIHrrr8ndeuCGFxZWT2jw.png?1783619095 | alt: ]
Select 1x1 and add a background color:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181780353/original/i3ow4l9t3kGjwQon8yW9BM1DB03s6yUSPQ.png?1783619280 | alt: ]
Now add in the elements or content:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149184767/original/53eDRDkDfcleiyCvQzvqdXrvaDv3HnGLYQ.png?1725908263 | alt: ]
